name: The Atelier
summary: A bright duplex under the eaves, ideal for longer stays.
description: A bright duplex under the roof, with exposed beams and windows over the old-town rooftops. Downstairs, a living room with a sofa bed and a work table; upstairs, the king bedroom beneath the skylight. Ideal for longer stays or unhurried travellers: a kitchenette, plenty of light and the murmur of the old quarter a step away. Noble materials and attic calm.
